Since the portal channel isn't available in my options, I'll reply via email as the tenant prefers, noting the heating pressure issue is likely ongoing. For the bin question, I should clarify that's a council matter for Tower Hamlets, not something we handle directly.

For the visit, I shouldn't invent a new ticket — the 14 Oct date comes from an existing system note, so I'll just reference it as "noted as 14 Oct" rather than confirming via set_visit myself. I'll set a follow-up for that same date.

arguments.body: Hi Jonah, thanks for your messages on the portal. Boiler (R-4799): the first engineer visited and quoted for replacing a part (the expansion vessel). Because of the cost, your landlord asked for a second quote, and our records show a second engineer (Swift P&H) due to visit on 14 October. Nothing is booked for the repair until the landlord decides after that. I'm sorry it feels slow. In the meantime, keep topping up the pressure as you have been. If you lose heating or hot water, or smell gas, tell us straight away (gas smell: leave the property and call 0800 111 999). We'll update you after the 14th. Bins: we don't handle collections, so please check the Tower Hamlets Council website or call them to report a missed collection. I can't give you a collection date myself.
